name: wuphf-dev-tooling
description: Root-level dev tooling (secretlint, commitlint). The Go v0 app lives at the repo root; web UI lives in ./web with its own package.json; v1 protocol package lives in ./packages/protocol; v1 broker package lives in ./packages/broker; v1 desktop shell lives in ./apps/desktop; installer-stub + release pipeline live in ./apps/installer-stub.
